Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer / Lead AI Engineer with 10+ years of overall technology experience and strong hands-on expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Python, and Cloud.

The candidate will be responsible for architecting, developing, deploying, and scaling enterprise-grade AI solutions and should be capable of taking AI initiatives from concept and architecture through production deployment and optimization.

The role requires a strong combination of hands-on engineering, solution architecture, technical leadership, and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

Architect and develop scalable AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
Design and implement LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, AI agents, and multi-agent architectures.
Build production-grade Agentic AI workflows involving reasoning, planning, tool/function calling, memory, orchestration, and enterprise API integration.
Design end-to-end RAG architectures, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, hybrid search, retrieval optimization, re-ranking, and response generation.
Work with LLMs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, or equivalent models.
Implement advanced Prompt Engineering and Context Engineering techniques.
Develop AI applications using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent frameworks.
Design and integrate Vector Databases / Vector Search solutions.
Develop scalable AI APIs and microservices using Python, FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent technologies.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, databases, APIs, and data platforms.
Establish LLM evaluation and testing frameworks for accuracy, grounding, hallucination, relevance, safety, latency, and cost.
Implement AI security, governance, guardrails, access control, data privacy, and responsible AI practices.
Deploy and operate AI solutions across Azure/AWS/GCP cloud environments.
Drive production readiness, including CI/CD, Docker, monitoring, logging, observability, scalability, and performance optimization.
Optimize AI systems for latency, throughput, reliability, model performance, and infrastructure cost.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities for enterprise adoption.
Lead technical discussions with architects, engineering teams, product teams, and business stakeholders.
Mentor senior and junior engineers and establish engineering best practices.
Conduct technical reviews and ensure adherence to architecture, coding, security, and development standards.
Build reusable AI frameworks, accelerators, components, and reference architectures.

Mandatory Skills

10+ years of overall experience in Software Engineering / AI / ML / Data Science / Technology.
Strong hands-on Python development experience.
Strong hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering.
Strong experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Proven experience designing and implementing RAG architectures.
Strong experience with Agentic AI / AI Agents / Multi-Agent Systems.
Strong Prompt Engineering / Context Engineering experience.
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
Experience with OpenAI / Azure OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / open-source LLMs.
Strong experience with Vector Databases and semantic search.
Experience building REST APIs / microservices using FastAPI or Flask.
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning / Deep Learning concepts.
Experience deploying AI solutions on AWS / Azure / GCP.
Strong understanding of AI system architecture, distributed systems, scalability, and system design.
Experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and production support.
Strong technical leadership and stakeholder-management skills.

Good to Have

MCP / Model Context Protocol experience.
Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, RAGAS, Promptfoo, or equivalent.
Experience with fine-tuning, SFT, LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, RLHF/DPO.
Knowledge of GraphRAG, Knowledge Graphs, Neo4j, or semantic search.
Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, or equivalent MLOps platforms.
Experience with AWS Bedrock / Azure AI Foundry / Vertex AI.
Experience with LLM gateways, model routing, caching, and cost optimization.
Experience with real-time AI / streaming architectures.
Experience with Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ, or event-driven architectures.
Knowledge of AI security, responsible AI, model governance, and enterprise compliance.
Experience leading AI modernization / legacy modernization initiatives.

Leadership Expectations

Provide technical leadership for AI/GenAI engineering teams.
Define architecture, technology standards, development patterns, and reusable frameworks.
Review and guide AI solution designs and production implementations.
Mentor engineers and conduct technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
Work directly with senior stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Drive PoC-to-production conversion and ensure enterprise-grade quality.
Contribute to AI capability building, innovation, and technical roadmap.

Principal AI Engineer

Location: India (Bengaluru) - 3(WFO)

Employment Type: Full Time (Overlapping EST)

Experience Level: Staff/Principal (8–14 years) 

Working Hours: Comfortable with a daily overlap into US Eastern morning hours (8AM - 12 PM EST)




8–14 years of software engineering experience, with strong hands-on large-scale Python

Working depth in at least one systems or backend language — Go, Rust, Java, or C/C++ — and the judgment to know when to reach for it

Strong data structures and algorithms. 

Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, and system design

Hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines and production-grade distributed systems.




Agentic AI and LLMs




2+ years of hands-on LLM engineering, with at least couple agentic system you designed and took to production

Production experience with agent frameworks — LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, or equivalent — and the fluency to move between them as the ecosystem evolves

Experience building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tool-calling interfaces

RAG from first principles: chunking strategy, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, reranking, and response validation

Strong experience with vector databases (Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, etc. or cloud equivalents)

Design of guardrails and reliability patterns — validators, policy checks, self-correction loops, deterministic fallbacks, circuit breakers, and rollback paths






Optimization




Deep familiarity with token optimization and context-window management — context shaping, pruning, and compaction

Latency and cost optimization through caching, model routing, batching, streaming, and parallel tool calls

Performance testing and tuning systems against defined SLOs




Evaluation




Experience building evaluation frameworks for LLM systems — offline eval sets, continuous online evaluation, and regression detection

Instrumentation and traceability suitable for regulated enterprise environments using tools like LangSmith, Langfuse, etc.




Cloud




Hands-on AWS: containerized services (ECS/EKS), serverless (Lambda), data services (S3, DynamoDB, Redshift) and orchestration (Step Functions)equivalents also valued

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation, and mature CI/CD practice




Working traits




Strong analytical problem-solving with a bias to ownership and urgency

Clear cross-team communication, working directly with client stakeholders to translate business problems into technical roadmaps

Able to work productively in ambiguity from system-level documentation and ramp quickly in unfamiliar codebases

Good to Have

Experience with managed AI platforms — Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure AI — paired with fluency in the underlying fundamentals

Azure or GCP 

Roles & Responsibilities

Design and build agentic systems: Lead the architecture and implementation of tool-calling agents that combine retrieval, structured reasoning, and secure action execution with least-privilege access.

Productionize LLM applications: Build retrieval pipelines, prompt synthesis, response validation, and self-correction loops, backed by rigorous evaluation.

Own the full stack: Deliver the data pipelines, backend services, distributed compute, and orchestration layer that agentic systems depend on — not only the model invocation.

Engineer for reliability and governance: Build validator models, adversarial test suites, and policy checks; enforce deterministic fallbacks and rollback strategies; instrument continuous evaluation.

Optimize for cost and latency: Drive measurable improvements in token efficiency, response time, and unit economics against defined SLOs.

Codebase ownership: Build, maintain, and review high-quality Python and SQL, with an emphasis on reusable components, scalability, and performance.

Cloud integration: Deploy AI applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP with optimized resource usage and robust CI/CD.

Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with product owners, data scientists, and business SMEs to define requirements and deliver impactful AI products.

Mentoring and technical leadership: Set engineering standards and share knowledge across the team, raising the bar on AI and software engineering practice.

The ideal candidate should have expertise in Python, SQL, AWS/Azure/GCP, LLMs, MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.



Roles and Responsibility

Design and develop scalable and efficient AI models using various machine learning algorithms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into existing systems.
Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines using SQL and other programming languages.
Implement automated testing and deployment scripts using Docker and Kubernetes.
Ensure seamless integration of AI models with backend services using APIs.
Participate in code reviews and improve the overall quality of the codebase.


Job Requirements

Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and other programming languages.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS/Azure/GCP.
Knowledge of machine learning frameworks and deep learning techniques.
Familiarity with containerization using Docker and orchestration using Kubernetes.
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
